name: skill-builder
description: Create, update, or install reusable standard Agent Skills, including approval-gated remote Skill installation through a constrained specialist agent.
workflow: Reference existing lightweight tools when possible.
Only create new impl.py tool sources when the user explicitly wants them.
When installing standard Agent Skills, preserve the upstream SKILL.md and generate Cowork indexing metadata only.
For a remote HTTPS Skill entry, use remote_skill_installer_agent instead of shell, npx, Git, or install_agent_skill.
When remote_skill_installer_agent returns needs_confirmation, request user approval before continuing with decision=confirm.
